dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: Building my mage's lodge was quite a rewarding experience. But as everyone knows, any mage worth her salt owns more than one garden. It's time to pick a new location, I think.

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: There's actually a very simple reason for it. If I only ever built one home, I might have to wait forever before someone stumbles in by mistake.

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: Not that I'm looking to build a bustling tourism hotspot or anything. But it would be a little embarrassing if no one ever visited at all... It'd be a bit like spending days preparing for an extravagant birthday banquet, only for no one to show up on the day.

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: And that is why I must expand my territory. A mage's power and might must be witnessed by the outside world, if only once in a while.

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: Welcome, welcome to the mage's lodge... Oh, wait, it's just you two.

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: I'm not in Nod-Krai at the moment. I'm actually in Sumeru, watching a Rishboland Tiger baring its teeth at me. There's tea on the table, though. Help yourselves.

choices.text: How long has this tea been brewing...

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: O ye of little faith! Rest assured that a mage's teapot will only ever be filled with freshly brewed tea.

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: Sorry, gotta go — it's charging right at me. Ah, what a brave little kitty...
